topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding cancer transformation and genetics.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how tumor virology revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of cancer mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the categories of cancer mutations and illustrate their functional effects on cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the origins of sequence and chromosomal instability arising from failures in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how stepwise mutation accumulation drives tumor progression and how inherited genetic defects accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the session, offers supplementary reading, and previews the subsequent lecture.
